name: The First Alkahistorian: Stage Two
storyline: After being knocked unconscious by the discovery made at the end of Stage 1, you wake up to find that your father has died while you were away. Now your goal changed, from making a cure for your father's illness to going back in time, to be able to stand by him during his last breaths.
summary: Take control of a young man and continue the research into the Elements 7 months since the first game, now with new systems and a new goal.
